org.portico.utils.messaging

Class MessageContext

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.messaging.MessageContext
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Externalizable, Serializable

    public class MessageContext
extends Object
implements Externalizable
    A MessageContext aggregates together a PorticoMessage and a ResponseMessage into a single logical unit that can be passed around the various messaging framework components.
    See Also:

      • getRequest

        public <X extends PorticoMessage> X getRequest(Class<X> type)
                                        throws MessagingException
        This method will cast the request method to the given type and return it. If there is no request, or the request isn't assignable to the given type, an exception will be thrown. At the same time, an ErrorResponse will be created and packaged into the context.
        Throws:
        MessagingException

      • getRequest

        public <X extends PorticoMessage> X getRequest(Class<X> type,
                                               IMessageHandler handler)
                                        throws MessagingException
        The functionality of this class is virtually the same as getRequest(Class) with the only difference being that the class of the given handler will be used in the error message.
        Throws:
        MessagingException

      • getResponse

        public ResponseMessage getResponse()

      • getErrorResponse

        public ErrorResponse getErrorResponse()
        Fetches the response as an ErrorResponse. If the response message is null, or is not an ErrorResponse, null will be returned.

      • getErrorResponseException

        public Exception getErrorResponseException()
        If the contained response is an ErrorResponse, this method will extract it and fetch the cause of the error, casting it to an Exception before returning it (it is stored as a Throwable). If the response doesn't exist, or isn't an instance of ErrorResponse, null is returned.

      • getSuccessResult

        public Object getSuccessResult()
        If the response message is set and is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, return the "result" field of it. If there is no response, or it is a different type, return null.

      • getSuccessResultMap

        public HashMap<String,Object> getSuccessResultMap()
        If the response message is set and is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, return its results map. If there is no response, or it is a different type, return null.

      • setResponse

        public void setResponse(ResponseMessage response)

      • isSuccessResponse

        public boolean isSuccessResponse()
        Returns true if the response message exists and is a success message. Returns false if the response message is null or is an error response.

      • hasResponse

        public boolean hasResponse()
        Returns true if a response has been filled out for this context (that is, if the response is not null), false if a response doesn't exist.

      • copy

        public MessageContext copy()
        Returns a copy of this context that uses the original request object, but not the response. If you intend to change the request message AFTER you have made a copy, be aware that it will change in the copy as well (as the reference to the request is just copied).
